tenderSchedule.title: Supply of Furniture to the Hostels at Jnana Bharathi Campus, Bangalore University, Bengaluru under CSR fund contribution from Walmart
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Furniture to the Hostels at Jnana Bharathi Campus, Bangalore University, Bengaluru under CSR fund contribution from Walmart

tenderAddress.blockNumber: in Board Room, Office of the Registrar, Jnanabharathi Campus, Bangalore University

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. Bangalore University shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. Bangalore University shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable. Conditional tenders will not be accepted

The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and Bangalore University will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable
Bangalore University is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka public Procurement Portal
The EMD & Tender processing fee shall be paid through Karnataka public procurement portal only as per the e-procurement rules
The Tenderers need to register with Karnataka public procurement portal and to obtain user ID and Password for participating in the Tender process
Bangalore University reserves the rights to Accept or Reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
No subsequent correspondence regarding price quoted will be entertained
Bidders should abide by other terms & conditions as prescribed in relevant KTPP standard tender document and KTPP Rules and KTPP Act
The Bidder shall comply with and abide by all the terms, conditions, specifications, and requirements stipulated in the tender document.
Tender received without adequate details will be rejected
The PDF/other files to be uploaded shall be prepared using the minimum appropriate resolution required to ensure readability and clarity of the contents.

For availing exemption for payment of EMD: The tenderers should be registered with National Small Industries Development Corporation Ltd. (NSIC) under a single point vendor registration. They should upload Government Purchase Enlistment Certificate from NSIC which will be verified online in the e-procurement portal. The exemption and relaxation in EMD is subject to the validity & acceptance of their registration certificate on the date of opening of tender. Only Udyam Registration Certificate will not be accepted for EMD exemption
The tenderer shall be the Original Equipment/Goods Manufacturer (OEM) or an Authorized distributor/ Dealers of the OEM with a valid authorization certificate to supply the furniture items
The technical offer should not contain the Price Information.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the Tenderer is an Original Equipment/Goods Manufacturer (OEM), he should have satisfactorily manufactured, supplied and installed furniture items similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 (three) completed Financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e. Financial Year 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024- 2025). This will be 40% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs)/startups in any one of the last 2 (two) completed Financial Years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Previous Purchase Orders along with the corresponding satisfactory Work Completion Certificates issued by the respective clients

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the Tenderer is an Authorized distributor/ Dealer, the tenderer, as authorized representative should have supplied and installed satisfactorily furniture items similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 30 % of the quantity required in any one of the last three years (i.e. Financial Year 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024- 2025)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Previous Purchase Orders along with the corresponding satisfactory Work Completion Certificates issued by the respective clients

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder/OEM should have been in similar business of Supply of furniture for a period of at least 3 years as on the last date of Bid Submission as evidenced by the Certificate of Commencement of Business issued by the Registrar of Companies or any other documentary proof (issued by the Government)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Commencement of Business issued by the Registrar of Companies or any other valid document issued by a Government authority

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In case of Authorized distributor/ Dealers of a manufacturer - The bidder must furnish Manufacturers Authorization Form as per Appendix C- Form 2 of Tender Document or any similar format

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Manufacturers Authorization Form in the prescribed format at  Appendix C- Form 2 or similar format
Others -- Registration Certificate issued by the competent authority shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall furnish a valid GST Registration Certificate along with copies of the GST returns filed for the last three months

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration and copies of the GST returns filed for the last three months
Others -- Copy of the PAN card

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should furnish the latest certificates of ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2015 from NABCB-accredited agencies or equivalent recognized board

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid certificates in this regard shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall furnish the details of Manufacturing Facilities along with photographs of machineries including Quality Control system available with them/their Manufacturer

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- details of the manufacturing facilities, along with photographs of the manufacturing machinery/equipment and the Quality Control system available

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of Service Centres and information on service support facilities in Bangalore that would be provided during and after the warranty period (in the Service Support Form given in Appendix C - Form 3)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Duly filled Service Support Form (Appendix C - Form 3) providing details of service centres and information on support facilities in Bengaluru

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should furnish Test certificate for the product confirming to IS 17636 standards issued by an NABL-accredited laboratory or BIS recognized testing Laboratory or Reports issued by competent Central/State government testing Institutions

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid test certificate shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Turnover of the Tenderer should not be less than Rs. 06 Crores (Rupees Six Crores only) for the last three preceding Financial years (i.e. Financial Year 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024- 2025). Micro and Small Enterprises bidder should have Average Annual Turnover of not less than Rs 3 Crore (Rupees Three Crores only) for the last 2 (two) preceding Financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual turnover Certificate of the tenderer attested by Registered Chartered accountant with UDIN number shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of Income Tax Returns filed for the last three financial years (2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024- 2025)

Audited Balance Sheet showing that, Bidders have been profitable for each of the last three financial years and should submit certified copy from chartered Accountant with UDIN Number /Company Auditors. (As proof, the bidder shall furnish audited Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements for each of the last three financial years, along with a certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant (with UDIN) or the Companys Statutory Auditor certifying that the bidder has been profitable in each of the last three financial years)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents as mentioned shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall, at their own cost, submit samples of each furniture item specified in the tender document, conforming to the prescribed technical specifications, before the opening of the Technical Bids i.e on or before 17.10.2026 before 5.00 PM

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Sample Submission Acknowledgement letter received from Bangalore University shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be blacklisted by the Government of Karnataka or any of its department/agency or by Central / any other State/UT Government or its department/ agency for the last Three years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration signed by Authorized signatory shall be submitted

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Any other supporting documents, as required in terms of the tender, to claim eligibility
Details of Tenderer in the format prescribed at Appendix B along with supporting documents
Filled Checklist in the letterhead of the tenderer
